description: Probes an endpoint (best of up to 3 tries) and returns an EIP-712 SLAAttestation signed by the AgentSLA oracle: httpStatus, latencyMs, slaMet, eip712Signature and oracleSigner, verifiable with ethers.verifyTypedData (domain and types: GET https://agentsla.io/v1/attestations). Use it when another party must be able to verify the result; for a quick free look use check_endpoint. Requires walletAddress to hold an active 7-day pass (5 USDC): check_pass shows it, buy_pass sells it. Without a pass it returns an error result explaining how to pay; nothing is charged. A listed endpoint's result is also added to its public check history.

endpointUrl.description: Full http(s) URL to probe, e.g. "https://api.example.com/health".

maxLatencyMs.description: Latency limit in milliseconds for slaMet.

walletAddress.description: Base Mainnet wallet holding an active pass, e.g. "0x1234...abcd" (40 hex characters after 0x).

walletSignature.description: personal_sign by walletAddress of "AgentSLA pass access\nWallet: <checksummed walletAddress>\nSigned at: <walletSignedAt>". Proves you control the pass wallet; no gas.

walletSignedAt.description: Unix seconds when walletSignature was made (within the last 5 minutes).

name: verify_endpoint_sla
title: Signed endpoint check
